Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should cany the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of tills pump
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valve
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Suitable lifting device feeler gauge.
Hammer, torque wrench.
Dial indicator.
Work to be Carried Out
Steps | Works to be Carried out | Setting 
 (reference value) | Test Results
1. | Check any vibration of the pump | 1.8 mm/s | 
2. | Check any noise of the pump | 90 dB | 
3. | Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box 
 and minimized it by retighten the mechanical seal bolts | OK Not OK | 
4. | Check any leakage from the pipe's connections to 
 the pump | OK Not OK | 
5. | Check leakage of lubricating grease in bearing 
 house of the pump | OK Not OK | 
6. | Check the pressure in the pump's delivery | OK Not OK | 
7. | Check the temperature of all bearing house, it 
 must be less than 70C | <70C | 
Steps | Works to be Carried out | Setting 
 (reference value) | Test Results
1. | Check the screw spindle and casing from mechanical wear and 
 measure the clearances by dismantle the pump | OK Not OK | 
2. | Check the bearings in pump | OK Not OK | 
3. | Change the mechanical seal if leakage is heavy and didn't 
 prevented by tighten | OK Not OK | 
4. | Prevent the leakage of lubricating grease from bearing house 
 of the pump | OK Not OK | 
5. | Change the lubricating grease in pump | 2/3 of oil side glass | 
6. | Check the coupling's bolts and change if needed | OK Not OK | 
7. | Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation | OK Not OK | 
8. | Check the alignment between pump and motor | OK Not OK |
